in_marathi.name: Jishan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's gracious gift
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jishan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jishan is derived from the Sanskrit language and is composed of two words: 'Ji' meaning 'God' and 'Shan' meaning 'gracious gift'. It is a name given to signify that the child is a divine blessing and a gift from the Almighty.
